title: Ingeniero de nube
description:
Nova oportunidade para Ingeniero de nube em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Top Skills' Details 1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations. 2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development). 3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery. 3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). 4.) Hands on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Job Description: Our Client is the nation's leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‐integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems. The Role We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‐stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‐native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications. You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‐on coding and deployment automation. Key Responsibilities Enterprise System Integration Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS, Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. Design and implement RESTful APIs, event‐driven integrations, and data‐sync pipelines. Lead integration efforts during M& A system consolidation, ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms. AWS Engineering & Architecture Build serverless and microservices‐based applications using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, and related AWS services. Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns. Full‐Stack Development Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern Java Script/Type Script frameworks. Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes. Advanced Development & Data Workflows Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS).‐performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS). Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‐scale data migrations and cross‐platform synchronization. Perform deep‐dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems. Technical Leadership & Collaboration Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‐vs‐Buy recommendations. Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies. Qualifications Required Technical Skills 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‐level AWS development experience‐driven architectures. Strong full‐stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‐native applications. Hands‐on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‐scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and Dev Ops tooling (Git Hub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.). Soft Skills Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‐cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‐functional business and engineering teams. Preferred Skills Experience with Event Bridge, App Flow, or enterprise i Paa S tools. Background in M& A system consolidation or multi‐system enterprise architecture.

title: Líder técnico iii (react native/nodejs)
description:
Confira a vaga para Líder técnico iii (react native/nodejs) em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar com liderança técnica de projetos de software, no Inatel Competence Center - ICC. Responsabilidades e atribuições Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software; Atuar na definição de soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade e desempenho; Definir, documentar e validar arquiteturas lógicas e executáveis de sistemas; Elaborar documentação técnica, arquitetural, operacional e de apoio à gestão dos projetos; Realizar especificação funcional e técnica de sistemas e aplicações; Prover soluções e suporte ao desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicativos móveis e web; Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível de complexidade técnica; Atuar em conjunto com o time de QA, apoiando estratégias de testes e qualidade; Revisar códigos-fonte, garantindo aderência a boas práticas, padrões de projeto e qualidade de software; Projetar soluções com foco em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD); Atuar como referência técnica, promovendo capacitação, mentoria e suporte aos desenvolvedores; Planejar, acompanhar e monitorar as atividades técnicas dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade; Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à evolução do projeto, arquitetura e infraestrutura. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia, tais como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software; Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando React Native, Expo e Node.js; Vivência com: Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares); Atuação em ambientes com cultura Dev Ops. Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis e aplicações web; Design e definição de arquitetura de aplicações móveis e backend; Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais; Desenvolvimento e consumo de Web Services e APIs REST; Aplicação de Design Patterns e boas práticas de engenharia de software; Modelagem e documentação de projetos; Ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex.: Git) e análise de qualidade de código; Atuação prévia com AWS (Amazon Web Services), incluindo: Conceitos de arquitetura em nuvem; Uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS/Dynamo DB, Lambda, API Gateway e Cloud Watch; Boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade; Apoio à definição de pipelines e ambientes em nuvem. Forte atuação com: Comunicação Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE); Comunicação em rede CAN; Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play; Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para build, testes e deploy; Testes automatizados; Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design. Informações adicionais Horário de Trabalho: de segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 17h30. title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Confira a vaga para Assessor de investimentos em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da geral: Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Financeiro com certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 para atuar no suporte e atendimento a clientes, análise de perfil de investidor, e distribuição de produtos financeiros. O(a) profissional ideal tem perfil analítico, boa comunicação e experiência no setor bancário ou de investimentos. Responsabilidades: Prestar atendimento e suporte técnico/consultivo a clientes pessoa física e jurídica; Realizar análises de perfil de investidor (suitability) e apoiar na recomendação de produtos financeiros; Comercializar produtos como CDB, LCI/LCA, fundos de investimento, previdência, entre outros; Apoiar a área comercial no processo de prospecção e fidelização de clientes; Atualizar cadastros, monitorar prazos e garantir conformidade com as normas da ANBIMA e do BACEN; Acompanhar indicadores e relatórios de desempenho da carteira de investimentos. Requisitos: Certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 (obrigatória); Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou corretoras; Conhecimento em produtos bancários e investimentos; Facilidade com sistemas bancários, Excel e plataformas de investimento; Boa comunicação, proatividade e foco em resultados. Diferenciais: Certificações adicionais (CEA, CFP, ANCORD); Vivência com atendimento consultivo em agências bancárias ou mesas de investimentos; Domínio de ferramentas como Smarkia, BLK, ou plataformas de investimentos digitais. Benefícios: Salário compatível com o mercado Participação nos lucros (PLR) Vale-refeição e alimentação Plano de saúde e odontológico Previdência privada Programa de desenvolvimento e capacitação contínua

title: English teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando English teacher em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature Co Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Software Engineer-SMART MODULE Founding smart-module engineer at Quectel's new Manaus hub Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Software Engineer – Smart Module – LATAM Level Mid-Level (3–5 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R& D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role Smart modules are where Quectel's cellular tech meets serious compute — Android and Linux platforms with camera, multimedia, and AI capabilities, powering everything from smart POS terminals to AI vision devices and connected industrial equipment. This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. \"Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better.\" What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R& D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: \"What is a smart module?\" by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R& D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R& D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. \"Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay.\" What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I2 C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Sr. compliance onboarding specialist em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices. Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions. Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions. Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks. Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments. Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly. Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus). Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira a vaga para Professor de inglês em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Professor de espanhol
description:
Confira a vaga para Professor de espanhol em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Enfermeiro
description:
Empresa está contratando Enfermeiro em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Vaga: Enfermeiro(a) — Programa Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras Salário: R$14.500,00 (2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios Localidade: Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação) Programa: Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras, da Sprache& Wissen Como funciona? Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), se inscreve para estudar alemão por até 2 anos na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, até atingir o nível B2 (final do intermediário). Antes de iniciar seus estudos, você recebe um contrato com garantia de emprego na Alemanha, com cláusulas específicas e seguras — desde que cumpra os requisitos do programa. Se a S& W não conseguir sua colocação após você atingir o B2, o valor investido é devolvido integralmente. Durante todo o período de estudo, você conta com mentoria direcionada da Sprache& Wissen. Quem é a Sprache& Wissen? A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%. Principais atividades (na Alemanha): Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador Requisitos: Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão) Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir) Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível) Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio Inglês intermediário ou avançado Sobre o período de estudos (home office): O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2 Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual Etapas do processo: Inscrição e triagem inicial Entrevista com o time da S& W Aprovação de ficha e documentações Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2) Match com recrutador alemão Colocação profissional na Alemanha

description:

Talent Acquisition Specialist About Us: We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it's grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions The Role: We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you're excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds. What You'll Do: Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client's mission Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes What we are looking for: Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing Who You Are: Someone who is not satisfied with "just good enough" and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way Fluent in English and Portuguese Are You Still Curious? If you've read this far, then chances are you've got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can't wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

description:

Linux Systems Engineer Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit 01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Nova oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. description:
